name: Dal Tadka with Jeera Rice

components.name: Dal Tadka

ingredients.name: Dry split yellow lentils, masoor/moong blend

steps: Rinse dried split lentils until water runs mostly clear. Simmer in 1000 ml measured water with turmeric until tender, generally 25-40 minutes; stir and add only documented extra water if necessary.
In a second saucepan soften onion in 22 ml oil, add ginger and minced garlic, then chopped tomatoes. Cook until thick and fragrant.
Combine tomato base with softened lentils and salt; simmer another 8 minutes to meld flavours.
Heat ghee, cumin seeds, dried chili and sliced garlic for 1-2 minutes until the garlic is golden, then pour the sizzling tempering over the cooked lentils.
Portion dal and jeera rice separately; reheat gently with a spoon of water since dal thickens overnight.

components.name: Jeera Rice
steps: Rinse basmati rice and cook with measured water. Toast cumin seeds briefly in the rice oil and fold through cooked rice.
